nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Single-Board Computer
nodes.rationale: Product photograph of a Raspberry Pi Model B-class board (Samsung LPDDR SDRAM package, Broadcom SoC, 40-pin GPIO header, 4x USB, Ethernet, HDMI, CSI camera connector, micro-USB power, 3.5mm AV jack). Included as the reference low-cost compute platform for on-farm edge deployment: it is cheap, low-power, has a native camera interface and GPIO for environmental sensors, which is why it is preferred over a PC or a pure-cloud design in resource-constrained poultry houses.

nodes.label: 40-Pin GPIO Header
nodes.rationale: The physical attachment point for temperature, humidity, CO2 and NH3 sensor breakouts; it is what makes the board a sensor hub rather than just a computer.

nodes.label: Low-Cost Edge Computing Hardware Choice
nodes.rationale: Trade-off captured by the figure: commodity SBC hardware trades raw inference throughput for price, power draw, ruggedness and replaceability, which suits poultry houses with intermittent connectivity where sending raw video to the cloud is infeasible.

edges.source_location: Ethernet + USB + GPIO make the board a candidate gateway
